Here are clear, customer-facing instructions you can send to your customer to ensure they can add their billing information to the **Ultisim** project within the **engageLively.com** Google Cloud organization.

---

## ✅ Instructions to Add Billing to the *Ultisim* Project

Hello,

You’ve been added as a **co-owner** of the Google Cloud project named **Ultisim**, under the **engageLively.com** organization. Please follow the steps below to add your billing information so we can begin using Google Cloud services.

### 🔐 Step 1: Sign In to Google Cloud Console
1. Go to: [https://console.cloud.google.com/](https://console.cloud.google.com/)
2. Make sure you're signed in with the **Google account** that has access to the project.

---

### 🧭 Step 2: Open the *Ultisim* Project
1. In the top menu bar, click the **project selector** (dropdown near the top-left corner).
2. In the list of projects, select **Ultisim** under the organization **engageLively.com**.

---

### 💳 Step 3: Set Up Billing
1. Once the *Ultisim* project is selected, click the **hamburger menu (☰)** in the top-left corner.
2. Go to **Billing > Link a billing account**.
   - If you don’t see that, go to **Billing** and then click **Manage billing accounts** or **Create billing account**.
3. Follow the prompts to:
   - **Create a new billing account** (if you don’t have one), or
   - **Link an existing billing account** to the *Ultisim* project.
4. Make sure billing is **successfully linked** to the project.

---

### 🔎 To Verify Billing Is Set
- Go to **Billing > Account Management**, and confirm that the *Ultisim* project is associated with an active billing account.

---

If you have any trouble during this process or don’t see the project listed, please let us know and we’ll make sure your access is correctly configured.

Thanks,  
*The engageLively Team*

---
